segments.snp3.7:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi yena āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
segments.snp3.7:1.3: Assosi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo “samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto.
segments.snp3.7:1.5: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.snp3.7:1.6: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti [bhagavā (syā. pī.)].
segments.snp3.7:1.7: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
segments.snp3.7:1.8: So dhammaṃ desati ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
segments.snp3.7:1.9: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.snp3.7:2.1: Atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.snp3.7:2.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.snp3.7:2.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
segments.snp3.7:2.4: Atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.7:2.5: “adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.snp3.7:2.6: Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.7:2.7: “mahā kho, keṇiya, bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni; tvañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno”ti.
segments.snp3.7:3.1: Dutiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.7:3.2: “kiñcāpi, bho gotama, mahā bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, ahañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno;
segments.snp3.7:3.3: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.snp3.7:3.4: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.7:3.5: “mahā kho, keṇiya, bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni; tvañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno”ti.
segments.snp3.7:4.1: Tatiyampi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.7:4.2: “kiñcāpi, bho gotama, mahā bhikkhusaṅgho aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni, ahañca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno, adhivāsetu [adhivāsetveva (sī.)] me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.snp3.7:4.5: Atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena sako assamo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā mittāmacce ñātisālohite āmantesi –
segments.snp3.7:4.6: “suṇantu me bhavanto mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, samaṇo me gotamo nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena, yena me kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ kareyyāthā”ti.
segments.snp3.7:4.9: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho keṇiyassa jaṭilassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā keṇiyassa jaṭilassa paṭissutvā appekacce uddhanāni khaṇanti, appekacce kaṭṭhāni phālenti, appekacce bhājanāni dhovanti, appekacce udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpenti, appekacce āsanāni paññāpenti.
segments.snp3.7:4.10: Keṇiyo pana jaṭilo sāmaṃyeva maṇḍalamāḷaṃ paṭiyādeti.
segments.snp3.7:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena selo brāhmaṇo āpaṇe paṭivasati, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo, tīṇi ca māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti.
segments.snp3.7:6.1: Tena kho pana samayena keṇiyo jaṭilo sele brāhmaṇe abhippasanno hoti.
segments.snp3.7:6.2: Atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi parivuto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami.
segments.snp3.7:6.3: Addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assame [keṇissamiye jaṭile (sī. pī.)] appekacce uddhanāni khaṇante … pe … appekacce āsanāni paññapente, keṇiyaṃ pana jaṭilaṃ sāmaṃyeva maṇḍalamāḷaṃ paṭiyādentaṃ.
segments.snp3.7:6.5: “kiṃ nu kho bhoto keṇiyassa āvāho vā bhavissati, vivāho vā bhavissati, mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito, rājā vā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenā”ti?
segments.snp3.7:7.1: “Na me, bho sela, āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā, nāpi rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyena;
segments.snp3.7:7.2: api ca kho me mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito.
segments.snp3.7:7.3: Atthi samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅguttarāpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto.
segments.snp3.7:7.4: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ … pe … buddho bhagavāti.
segments.snp3.7:7.6: So me nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.snp3.7:8.2: “ghosopi kho eso dullabho lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ buddhoti.
segments.snp3.7:8.3: Āgatāni kho panamhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
segments.snp3.7:8.4: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
segments.snp3.7:8.5: Tassimāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyathidaṃ – cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
segments.snp3.7:8.7: Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
segments.snp3.7:8.8: So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
segments.snp3.7:8.9: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado [vivattacchaddo (sī. pī.)].
segments.snp3.7:8.10: Kahaṃ pana, bho keṇiya, etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho”ti?
segments.snp3.7:9.1: Evaṃ vutte, keṇiyo jaṭilo dakkhiṇaṃ bāhuṃ paggahetvā selaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.7:9.3: Atha kho selo brāhmaṇo tīhi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
segments.snp3.7:9.4: Atha kho selo brāhmaṇo te māṇavake āmantesi –
segments.snp3.7:9.6: Durāsadā hi te bhagavanto [bhavanto (syā. ka.)] sīhāva ekacarā.
segments.snp3.7:9.7: Yadā cāhaṃ, bho, samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ manteyyuṃ, mā me bhonto antarantarā kathaṃ opātetha;
segments.snp3.7:10.1: Atha kho selo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.snp3.7:10.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.snp3.7:10.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi [sammannesi (sī. syā.)].
segments.snp3.7:10.4: Addasā kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
segments.snp3.7:10.5: Dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati – kosohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya cāti.
segments.snp3.7:11.2: “passati kho me ayaṃ selo brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
segments.snp3.7:11.3: Dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati – kosohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya cā”ti.
segments.snp3.7:11.5: Atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi [abhisaṅkhāresi (syā. ka.)], yathā addasa selo brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
segments.snp3.7:11.6: Atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalampi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
segments.snp3.7:12.2: “samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi, no apuripuṇṇehi.
segments.snp3.7:12.3: No ca kho naṃ jānāmi buddho vā no vā.
segments.snp3.7:12.4: Sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuḍḍhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.snp3.7:12.5: ‘ye te bhavanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā, te sake vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attānaṃ pātukarontī’ti.
segments.snp3.7:12.6: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyan”ti.
segments.snp3.7:12.7: Atha kho selo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi –
segments.snp3.7:23.3: Pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddhosmi brāhmaṇa.
segments.snp3.7:25.1: “Yesaṃ ve [yesaṃ vo (pī.), yassa ve (syā.)] dullabho loke, pātubhāvo abhiṇhaso;
segments.snp3.7:29.1: “Yo maṃ icchati anvetu, yo vā nicchati gacchatu;
segments.snp3.7:30.1: “Evañce [etañce (sī. pī.)] ruccati bhoto, sammāsambuddhasāsane [sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)];
segments.snp3.7:33.1: Alattha kho selo brāhmaṇo sapariso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
segments.snp3.7:33.2: Atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena sake assame paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi –
segments.snp3.7:33.4: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
segments.snp3.7:34.1: Atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
segments.snp3.7:34.2: Atha kho keṇiyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.snp3.7:34.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi –
segments.snp3.7:35.3: Rājā mukhaṃ manussānaṃ, nadīnaṃ sāgaro mukhaṃ.
segments.snp3.7:36.3: Puññaṃ ākaṅkhamānānaṃ, saṅgho ve yajataṃ mukhan”ti.
segments.snp3.7:37.1: Atha kho bhagavā keṇiyaṃ jaṭilaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.snp3.7:37.2: Atha kho āyasmā selo sapariso eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasse … pe … aññataro kho panāpasmā selo sapariso arahataṃ ahosi.
segments.snp3.7:38.1: Atha kho āyasmā selo sapariso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.snp3.7:39.1: “Yaṃ taṃ saraṇamāgamha [māgamma (sī. syā. ka.)], ito aṭṭhami cakkhuma;
segments.snp3.7:40.1: “Tuvaṃ buddho tuvaṃ satthā, tuvaṃ mārābhibhū muni;
segments.snp3.7:40.3: Tuvaṃ anusaye chetvā, tiṇṇo tāresimaṃ pajaṃ.
segments.snp3.7:42.3: Pāde vīra pasārehi, nāgā vandantu satthuno”ti.

lines: Paripuṇṇakāyoti lakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇatāya ahīnaṅgapaccaṅgatāya ca paripuṇṇasarīro.
Surucīti sundarasarīrappabho.
Sujātoti ārohapariṇāhasampattiyā saṇṭhānasampattiyā ca sunibbatto.
Cārudassanoti sucirampi passantānaṃ atittijanakaṃ appaṭikūlaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ cāru eva dassanaṃ assāti cārudassano.
Keci pana bhaṇanti “cārudassanoti sundaranetto”ti.
Suvaṇṇavaṇṇoti suvaṇṇasadisavaṇṇo.
Asīti bhavasi.
Etaṃ sabbapadehi yojetabbaṃ.
Susukkadāṭhoti suṭṭhu sukkadāṭho.
Bhagavato hi dāṭhāhi candakiraṇā viya ativiya paṇḍararaṃsiyo niccharanti.
Tenāha –
“susukkadāṭhosī”ti.
Mahāpurisalakkhaṇāti pubbe vuttabyañjanāneva vacanantarena nigamento āha.
Idāni tesu lakkhaṇesu attano abhirucitehi lakkhaṇehi bhagavantaṃ thunanto āha –
“pasannanetto”tiādi.
Bhagavā hi pañcavaṇṇapasādasampattiyā pasannanetto, paripuṇṇacandamaṇḍalasadisamukhattā sumukho, ārohapariṇāhasampattiyā brahā, bahmujugattatāya uju, jutimantatāya patāpavā.
Yampi cettha pubbe vuttaṃ, taṃ “majjhe samaṇasaṅghassā”ti iminā pariyāyena thunatā puna vuttaṃ.
Īdiso hi evaṃ virocati.
Esa nayo uttaragāthāyapi.
557-8. Uttamavaṇṇinoti uttamavaṇṇasampannassa.
Jambusaṇḍassāti jambudīpassa.
Pākaṭena issariyaṃ vaṇṇayanto āha, apica cakkavatti catunnampi dīpānaṃ issaro hoti.
Khattiyāti jātikhattiyā.
Bhojāti bhogiyā.
Rājānoti ye keci rajjaṃ kārentā.
Anuyantāti anugāmino sevakā.
Rājābhirājāti rājūnaṃ pūjaniyo rājā hutvā, cakkavattīti adhippāyo.
Manujindoti manussādhipati paramissaro hutvā.
Evaṃ vutte bhagavā “ye te bhavanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā, te sake vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attānaṃ pātukarontī”ti imaṃ selassa manorathaṃ pūrento āha “rājāhamasmī”ti.

Tatrāyamadhippāyo – yaṃ kho maṃ tvaṃ sela yācasi “rājā arahasi bhavituṃ cakkavattī”ti, ettha appossukko hoti, rājāhamasmi, sati ca rājatte yathā añño rājā samānopi yojanasataṃ vā anusāsati, dve tīṇi vā cattāri vā pañca vā yojanasatāni yojanasahassaṃ vā cakkavatti hutvāpi catudīpapariyantamattaṃ vā, nāhamevaṃ paricchinnavisayo.
Ahañhi dhammarājā anuttaro bhavaggato avīcipariyantaṃ katvā tiriyaṃ appameyyā lokadhātuyo anusāsāmi.
Yāvatā hi apadadvipadādibhedā sattā, ahaṃ tesaṃ aggo.
Na hi me koci sīlena vā … pe … vimuttiñāṇadassanena vā paṭibhāgo atthi.

Svāhaṃ evaṃ dhammarājā anuttaro anuttareneva catusatipaṭṭhānādibhedabodhipakkhiyasaṅkhātena dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi “idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathā”tiādinā āṇācakkaṃ,“idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan”tiādinā (saṃ. ni.5.1081; mahāva.14) pariyattidhammena dhammacakkameva vā.
Cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyanti yaṃ cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ hoti samaṇena vā … pe … kenaci lokasminti.
561-2. Evaṃ attānaṃ āvikarontaṃ bhagavantaṃ disvā pītisomanassajāto selo daḷhikaraṇatthaṃ “sambuddho paṭijānāsī”ti gāthādvayamāha.
Tattha ko nu senāpatīti dhammarañño bhoto, dhammena pavattitassa dhammacakkassa anuppavattako senāpati koti pucchi.
Tena ca samayena bhagavato dakkhiṇapasse āyasmā sāriputto nisinno hoti suvaṇṇapuñjo viya siriyā sobhamāno, taṃ dassento bhagavā “mayā pavattitan”ti gāthamāha.
Tattha anujāto tathāgatanti tathāgatahetu anujāto, tathāgatena hetunā jātoti attho.
Evaṃ “ko nu senāpatī”ti pañhaṃ byākaritvā yaṃ selo āha –
“sambuddho paṭijānāsī”ti, tatra naṃ nikkaṅkhaṃ kātukāmo “nāhaṃ paṭiññāmatteneva paṭijānāmi, apicāhaṃ iminā kāraṇena buddho”ti ñāpetuṃ “abhiññeyyan”ti gāthamāha.
Tattha abhiññeyyanti vijjā ca vimutti ca.
Maggasaccasamudayasaccāni pana bhāvetabbapahātabbāni, hetuvacanena pana phalasiddhito tesaṃ phalāni nirodhasaccadukkhasaccānipi vuttāneva bhavanti.
Yato sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikataṃ, pariññeyyaṃ pariññātanti evampettha vuttameva hoti.
Evaṃ catusaccabhāvanāphalañca vijjāvimuttiṃ dassento “bujjhitabbaṃ bujjhitvā buddho jātosmī”ti yuttena hetunā buddhattaṃ sādheti.
565-7. Evaṃ nippariyāyena attānaṃ pātukatvā attani kaṅkhāvitaraṇatthaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ abhittharayamāno “vinayassū”ti gāthāttayamāha.
Tattha sallakattoti rāgasallādisattasallakattano.
Brahmabhūtoti seṭṭhabhūto.
Atituloti tulaṃ atīto upamaṃ atīto, nirūpamoti attho.
Mārasenappamaddanoti “kāmā te paṭhamā senā”tiādikāya “pare ca avajānātī”ti (su. ni.440; mahāni.28; cūḷani. nandamāṇavapucchāniddesa 47) evaṃ vuttāya māraparisasaṅkhātāya mārasenāya pamaddano.
Sabbāmitteti khandhakilesābhisaṅkhāramaccudevaputtamārādike sabbapaccatthike.
Vasīkatvāti attano vase vattetvā.
Akutobhayoti kutoci abhayo.
568-70. Evaṃ vutte selo brāhmaṇo tāvadeva bhagavati sañjātappasādo pabbajjāpekkho hutvā “imaṃ bhavanto”ti gāthāttayamāha yathā taṃ paripākagatāya upanissayasampattiyā sammā codiyamāno.
Tattha kaṇhābhijātikoti caṇḍālādinīcakule jāto.
Tato tepi māṇavakā tatheva pabbajjāpekkhā hutvā “etañce ruccati bhoto”ti gāthamāhaṃsu yathā taṃ tena saddhiṃ katādhikārā kulaputtā.
Atha selo tesu māṇavakesu tuṭṭhacitto te dassento pabbajjaṃ yācamāno “brāhmaṇā”ti gāthamāha.
